spirits.line: Like you and a pack of American Spirits
stanza: I was wearing the same dress
You served out a three-year sentence
You read The Bible, Siddhartha, and Malcolm X
Like you and a pack of American Spirits

spirits.line: Of all these weird creatures who lock up their spirits
stanza: Makin' home movies for the folks back home
Of all these weird creatures who lock up their spirits
Drill holes in 'emselves, and live for their secrets
